purpose: Document first-party local/provincial cadastral-map evidence and bounded anonymous safe geometry review.
registryAssessment: The official Punjab PULSE viewer exposes a GPC Parcels map service operated on the Punjab Land Records Authority GIS host. This is actual public cadastral/map evidence, so registryFound is true; the evidence is provincial and does not prove a separate Joharabad local registry custodian or citywide coverage.

attempts.result: Viewer HTML fetched; current service URLs and /api/gis/token route were visible.
Anonymous viewer token route returned a short-lived token; token value was not retained or published. No login or credentials used.
Direct metadata request without viewer token was rejected as Token Required.
Metadata returned one GPC Parcel polygon layer with query support and WKID 4326; field names inspected only.
Exact WUP point query returned an empty FeatureCollection. This is not evidence of citywide absence.
Bounded envelope returned three polygon features; retained sample keeps only canonical GPCParcelId properties.
